Synopsis:
This dialog covers an edge case: the player has freed Iron throne prisoners, returned to the foundry and recruited Toobin as a follower. On the way to the control centre a kill switch accidentally goes off, killing all the gondians.Because of this Toobin is ready to give up. The player may attempt to persuade him to keep going.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_FundangoLosesHope.json: You freed Iron Throne prisoners and recruited Zanner Toobin — the Gondian leader who asked you to go to the Foundry’s lowest floor and destroy the Control Centre — and you’re now standing before the Neurocitor, a neural switchboard that links and controls the Steel Watchers. While approaching the control hub, a kill switch accidentally triggered, detonating the collars/devices attached to the Gondians and slaughtering Toobin’s comrades; he’s kneeling, traumatized and ready to give up. Off‑screen, the Neurocitor’s illithid‑blended tech makes the device hard to read or simply blow up without wider consequences, so finishing the job may require persuasion, technical checks, or a careful plan. The player’s lines are an attempt to steady Toobin and keep him committed to destroying the Foundry despite his grief.
- LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_Confrontation_AfterIRN.json: This dialog plays if the player solves the Iron Throne before ever seeing the LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_DeadMansSwitchThreat dialog.After destroying the Iron Throne the player walks in Baneites tormenting Gondian Workers in the Foundry Work room.With the Iron Throne gone, the dead mans switch no longer works.
- LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_GondianWorker08_Leader_AfterIRN.json: You’re speaking with Zanner Toobin, the Gondian leader who replaced the Iron Throne; his young daughter Obelia was recently trapped in a prison that exploded and — off-screen — the player rescued her, leaving Toobin panicked then overwhelmingly relieved. He’s asking you to go to the Foundry’s lowest floor and destroy the Control Centre. That Control Centre is the Neurocitor, a Gondian–illithid neural switchboard that serves as the Steel Watch’s central hub and links/controls every Watcher. Off-screen context: the Neurocitor’s blended tech makes ordinary steel or simple magic ineffective, you can attempt checks to decipher its symbols, and the intended way to disable it is to trigger an explosion — a solution that risks cascading effects across the Watcher network.
- LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_GondianWorker02.json: The different states for a Gondian in the foundry. In this dialogue Frell can be - terrified and working on a watcher under the watchful gaze of an overseers, post fight with said overseers, post the iron throne exploding (doesn't know if his wife is safe or not), and alone now that toobin (his leader) has been killed and he's freaking out about how to remove his collar/leave the foundry.
- LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_GondianWorker03.json: The different states for a Gondian in the foundry. In this dialogue Frell can be - terrified and working on a watcher under the watchful gaze of an overseers, post fight with said overseers, post the iron throne exploding (doesn't know if his mother is safe or not), and alone now that toobin (his leader) has been killed and he doesn't know what to do.
